verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ  ਕਵਨ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kavan a(n)jan kar lochan bilokeeat  kavan ku(n)ddal kar sravan suneejeeaai ||

en.bdb: By the use of which collyrium in the eyes can one see the beloved Lord? What ear-rings can help hear his sound?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਤੰਮੋਲ ਕਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਰਸੈ  ਕਉਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਕਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kavan ta(n)mol kar rasanaa sujas rasai  kaun kar ka(n)kan namasakaar keejeeaai ||

en.bdb: Which betel leaf when chewed can help the tongue repeat the supreme praise of the beloved Lord? What bangles should be worn in the hands to greet and salute Him?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਹਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਅਤ  ਕਉਨ ਅੰਗੀਆ ਸੁ ਕਰ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਦੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kavan kusam haar kar ur dhaareeat  kaun a(n)geeaa su kar a(n)kamaal dheejeeaai ||

en.bdb: What flower garland can make Him reside in the heart? What bodice should be worn to embrace Him with hands?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਪੇਟ ਲੀਜੈ  ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥੬੨੬॥
verses.translit_en: kaun heer cheer lapaTai kai lapeT leejai  kavan sa(n)jog pirayaa prem ras peejeeaai ||626||

en.bdb: What dress and diamond can be worn to entice Him? With what method can the union of the beloved be relished? The crux of the whole thing is that all embellishments are worthless. Relishing His love can only unite one with Him.  (626)
